name: Platt's Lane Estates townhouses, 472–490
summary: Ten two-storey townhouses are arranged in five staggered pairs with the central pair stepped back. A front footpath runs along the east, enclosed areas sit to the west, and broad trees overhang the roof.
lidarNote: Regional-2m LiDAR gives a P50 of 6.85 m, P90 of 12.98 m, and maximum of 13.14 m, indicating a two-storey townhouse block whose upper quantiles are skewed by canopy returns. High values are largely confined to the southeast end, northern modules sampled individually give medians of 6.4 to 6.7 m, the aerial shows the same two-storey silhouette throughout, P90 is unreliable, and the roof should be modelled from the two-storey repeat.

evidence.note: Five stepped pairs with identical roof slopes throughout including the tree-covered south end, with a warm brown roof colour from a 7 by 7 pixel sample in 2025 aerial-source.jpg centered at (196, 180) measuring #7b6857.

Western Housing shows a rear kitchen window, a separate dining-room patio door and projecting privacy walls. The three-bedroom plan also shows a single exterior kitchen door.
The 1 m return grid supplies two roof slopes and a ground-plan alignment correction of +0.0 m east and +0.5 m south.
